behavior.contract: All recognized multi-sentence rule paragraphs are one ordered source group; the selector offers the complete visible group as one original ID and emits its original text. The legacy sentence path may retain sentence-sized review only when all original parts are consecutive, same-source, and in original order. Header fragments are joined to the group when the existing global original-unit parser spans that paragraph boundary.
behavior.bounds: Uses _blocks paragraph boundaries and shared originalabschnitt_stellen offsets. Hidden, excerpted, or over-limit rule paragraphs cannot be offered as isolated units and lead to quote fallback. Completeness runs after first validation and second gate, after program additions, and when restoring saved output.
behavior.intentional_ux_cost: Multi-sentence paragraphs with any recognized normative signal are output as a complete group, including companion sentences that may be independently factual or normative. Rejected/hidden/oversize companions lead to quote fallback. This is a structural guard, not semantic entailment, authority, source-truth, or a universal grammar proof.

intentional_contract_changes: Legacy isolated rule sentences from a multi-sentence rule paragraph now fall back to source quotes, including paragraphs whose companion sentences are all normative.
